_about: Reviewed corrections to the members of the organizations in tools/lib/organizations.mjs, checked against the organizations' member lists in October 2026. Keys are region IDs. Each value gives the reason. Suspended members stay members.

UNSC.CHN: Permanent member under the UN Charter.
UNSC.FRA: Permanent member under the UN Charter.
UNSC.GBR: Permanent member under the UN Charter.
UNSC.RUS: Permanent member under the UN Charter.
UNSC.USA: Permanent member under the UN Charter.

UN observer.PSE: Non-member observer state since 29 November 2012. The Factbook has no entry for Palestine.

WTO.COM: Joined on 21 August 2024. The Factbook still lists it as an observer.

LAS.PSE: Member since 1976. The Factbook has no entry for Palestine.

OIC.PSE: Member since 1969. The Factbook has no entry for Palestine.

OECD.IND: A key partner of the OECD, not a member.

BRICS.SAU: Invited in 2023. Saudi Arabia has not confirmed its membership.

ASEAN.AUS: A dialogue partner, not a member.

OAS.NIC: Its withdrawal took effect on 19 November 2023.
